title: is_ac_id refuses the criterion label stored for a git-style package; criterion labels have three validators
body:
Found by ST0095's close-time Highlander sweep (vc, 2026-11-22, close A finding 4; start clusters C1, C9). Fixed under hv decision 86.

`preconditions.rs` `is_ac_id` is a second criterion-label validator that accepts only digit groups. It refuses `AC-<hex>.n`, the label `id::regrouped` stores for a git-style package and `contract::group_of` accepts. legacy.rs carries a third, v2-only shape check. Its reach today is ST0057's gate block.

Expected: one label reader in the waist (id.rs, over `label_parts` / `group_of`) that every validator calls, so a label the tool stores is never refused by another part of the tool.
